subject: burrowing owl
title: Burrowing Owls Spread Dung Around Their Door, and It Works

scenes.text: This owl decorates its front door with something disgusting.
Burrowing owls collect cow, horse and dog dung, and scatter it around their burrow.
Scientists guessed it hid the smell of their eggs. They tested it. It didn't.
So a Florida team cleared the dung and put cow manure back at only half the burrows.
The owls with dung ate ten times more dung beetles. The beetles walked right to the door.
So that mess on the doorstep isn't decoration. It's bait.

description:
Burrowing owls scatter cow, horse and dog dung around the entrances of their burrows. A Florida experiment published in Nature found it was not hiding egg scent from predators.
When researchers put cow manure at some burrows and none at others, the owls with dung ate about ten times more dung beetles. The dung works as bait.
What is the smartest hunting trick you know of?
